findings.summary: Carried from Contract+RED: map item 9 ('round-trips structured-clone values') and goal.md's agent carrier line (goal.md:184-189, 'structured-clone passthrough') still describe the raw passthrough ADR-0448 rejects. The line is an agent decision, not a user one, and goal/map/ledger are unchanged BASE..HEAD, so this is no drift. Align the map wording at re-chart.

Supporting repair outside the numbered clauses: inherited stdin now goes through a reader hook instead of a 'data' listener. It is required: Acceptance 4's browser-unit carrier (same-realm-program on the Chromium Worker route) times out without it, and it has a Node oracle (evidence §Inherited stdin), a RED and a CHANGELOG line. Note one semantic: with no parent reader, inheritors now drain pending chunks (process.ts:330-341) that a later parent read() would otherwise have seen. That matches Node's shared-fd race and is not a claimed behavior.

findings.summary: The unit RED for the stdin repair uses a structural EventEmitter stand-in for the Worker child's handle (stdin/stdout/stderr/close) instead of a real kernel Worker handle. Acceptance does not rest on it: the real Chromium carrier (advanced-ipc.spec.ts same-realm-program) discriminates the same defect (M11). Advisory: prefer a real-handle carrier when one can run in the unit tier.
